purpose: Entity, transform, hierarchy, and typed component authoring through the public Scene surface.
read_policy: Use these contracts first. Open only the exact header when a template signature or failure enum still needs confirmation.

contracts.summary: Register stable typed components before the registry is frozen; the returned ComponentTypeHandle<T> is used by Scene component operations.
Create an entity from EntityDescriptor; semanticId, name, tags, and Transform2D are authored directly in the descriptor.
Attach a typed component with the registry-owned ComponentTypeHandle<T>; validation is applied before insertion.
Resolve an attached typed component without string lookup. FindBySemanticId() is available when semantic entity lookup is required.
Mutate the entity Transform2D directly for ordinary semantic position/rotation/scale state.
